findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_playbooks, get_playbook_reference, get_playbook_kit · Private data: get_reg, lookup_citation, verify_quote, list_playbooks, start_playbook, get_playbook_reference, get_playbook_kit · Public sink: verify_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_playbooks, get_playbook_reference, get_playbook_kit · Private data: get_reg, lookup_citation, verify_quote, list_playbooks, start_playbook, get_playbook_reference, get_playbook_kit · Public sink: verify_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
